focus: SPEC 2.2 (controller param boundary), 2.3 (hook param), and the NEW controller spec (part of 2.8)

findings.title: Controller spec's rejection test is not falsifiable for the rescore_requested requirement (rule 26)
findings.spec_requirement: SPEC 2.8: 'Create the controller spec ... request without rescore_requested is rejected'. Task instruction: assertions must be falsifiable (core rule 26); the feature-under-test is the boundary requiredness added by SPEC 2.2 (`params.require(:ai_job_application_summary).require(:rescore_requested)`).
findings.evidence: Test 1 ('rejects a request without rescore_requested', lines 773-781) posts `params: { job_application_id: ..., ai_job_application_summary: {} }` and expects `ActionController::ParameterMissing`. The empty (blank/absent) `ai_job_application_summary` payload makes the OUTER `params.require(:ai_job_application_summary)` (controller line 44) raise before `.require(:rescore_requested)` is ever evaluated. Mentally deleting the inner `.require(:rescore_requested)` from the controller (the exact declaration this test claims to guard) leaves `params.require(:ai_job_application_summary)` in place, which still raises ParameterMissing on the empty hash, so the test still passes. The assertion therefore provides zero coverage that `rescore_requested` specifically is required; it only proves the top-level key is required. This is the rule-26 tautology pattern. (Confirmed against Rails `require`: blank/absent value raises; `attribute :ai_summary_rescore_requested, :boolean` in job_application.rb:11 is irrelevant here because line 17 is never reached.)
findings.recommendation: Post a NON-EMPTY `ai_job_application_summary` payload that is missing only `rescore_requested` (e.g. `ai_job_application_summary: { job_application_id: job_application.id }` or any sibling key) so the outer `require(:ai_job_application_summary)` passes and ONLY `.require(:rescore_requested)` can raise ParameterMissing. Then removing the inner require fails the test, making it falsifiable for the actual feature. Test 2 (threading) is correct and falsifiable and needs no change.
